intro: I'll be your AI assistant. When you show me your work, I watch, ask why at the right moments and remember it, so your know-how can help the next person. When you're learning something new, I'm right next to you, in your expert's own words. How should I work with you?

quiet.title: Silent observer
quiet.description: I watch and stay out of your way. I only speak up for what really matters: a limit, an exception or a mistake.

normal.title: Balanced
normal.description: A few questions at natural pauses, and help whenever you ask. Everything else waits until you're done.

curious.title: Active coach
curious.description: I ask more as you go and offer tips along the way, without you having to ask first.
